purpose: Review official Taiwan/NLSC and Changhua land-office channels for safe anonymous cadastral geometry and stable parcel identifiers.
assessment: Changhua has a local official land office and Taiwan's NLSC public cadastral reference viewer. The current viewer code identifies a public cadastral overlay service, but the exact unchanged WUP-point request returned a no-land-number message and the public location query returned an empty body. No full polygon, native parcel ID, or absence conclusion was recorded.
